### Research Notes: GoHighLevel (GHL)

#### **What the product does**
GoHighLevel is an all-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform designed primarily for agencies. It consolidates tools for lead generation, funnel building, email/SMS marketing, appointment scheduling, and pipeline management into a single white-labelable interface.
*   **Source:** [marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/) — "Complete REST API documentation for the HighLevel CRM platform. Build powerful integrations with our comprehensive developer resources."
*   **Source:** [clickfunnels.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFyJy6g-9Zfq2ghnbBq0YfM3Xkhd4MSpFbIa_Ien4y_M2JKegZ8rmIkcfoGtjHB0wodvDp2Wus2dcoZCSDPT0VPnk_mVsnJrVRe3wOcsztL7niyAansLRuxtPCjCeihVtR6zWRUJTGDn9YccSzS8NAezw==) — "Every core feature is included at this tier: the CRM, the website and funnel builder, workflow automation, booking calendars, and reputation management."

#### **API Auth Methods**
GoHighLevel supports two primary authentication methods for its V2 API:
1.  **OAuth 2.0:** Used for public marketplace apps and multi-tenant integrations. It supports PKCE.
2.  **Private Integration Token (Bearer Token):** Used for internal, single-tenant, or location-specific integrations.
*   **Multi-tenant Integration Choice:** **OAuth 2.0**.
*   **Source:** [marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/oauth-20](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/oauth-20) — "HighLevel supports: ... OAuth 2.0 for public integrations and Marketplace apps requiring user authorization."
*   **Source:** [marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/) — "curl -X GET ... -H 'Authorization: Bearer your_token'"

#### **Developer Access & Cost**
*   **Access Category:** `self_serve_free` (for development).
*   **Credential Process:** Developers can sign up for a free Developer Account at the HighLevel Marketplace. Once signed in, they can create an app to generate a `ClientId` and `ClientSecret`.
*   **Sandbox:** A free Sandbox environment is available for testing, limited to 2 sub-accounts and a 6-month active duration.
*   **Production Cost:** While the developer portal is free, **production API access** for end-users requires a paid plan. The "Starter" plan ($97/mo) does **not** include API access; users must be on the "Unlimited" plan ($297/mo) or higher.
*   **Source:** [gohighlevel.com (Sandbox Policy)](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGZuq3NMJxZn0O2DqTJO1M_HYUkFT9JQ45voHbJwN_KiWdb9nO8aLWmXMpe380_NwJju4n6ibxt7Pufot1PG8GX01cQ2DgE77xH13kP9FWjckIY_BBRI3i7lteSr1h631fxWzMgwhdGtM3iJTqcF_OjjhGcuMv4T5-JCrior6_EqFFxpTiwXjOSnuhZHLk=) — "The HighLevel Sandbox account is designed to give partners, developers, and customers a safe, non-production environment to explore, build, and test."
*   **Source:** [clickfunnels.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFyJy6g-9Zfq2ghnbBq0YfM3Xkhd4MSpFbIa_Ien4y_M2JKegZ8rmIkcfoGtjHB0wodvDp2Wus2dcoZCSDPT0VPnk_mVsnJrVRe3wOcsztL7niyAansLRuxtPCjCeihVtR6zWRUJTGDn9YccSzS8NAezw==) — "Starter doesn't include rebilling or API access... Unlimited... includes basic API access."

#### **API Details**
*   **Style:** REST.
*   **Breadth:** Comprehensive, covering Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Opportunities, Payments, Users, Blogs, and more.
*   **OpenAPI Spec:** Available via the official GitHub repository and Stoplight-based developer portal.
*   **Webhooks:** Supported with over 50 event types.
*   **Source:** [marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/) — "Access all HighLevel platform features through our REST API... Real-time notifications for 50+ events."
*   **Source:** [github.com/GoHighLevel/highlevel-api-docs](https://github.com/GoHighLevel/highlevel-api-docs) — "This repository contains... Markdown and OpenAPI-based documentation for easy readability and automation."

#### **MCP Servers**
*   **Status:** **Official**.
*   **Details:** GoHighLevel hosts the "LeadConnector MCP server," which allows AI agents to interact with CRM data.
*   **Endpoints:** 
    *   Claude: `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2`
    *   OpenAI/Generic: `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/openai/v2/`
*   **Source:** [gohighlevel.com](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHc90fT9Hrg5fwDYmvBQrv-9F1o2fjbGviQNJ3ljiviFiueoulr88WuteY1XYvKXAbnI1e6aKqpDkzwq4W96o8RGnserytrz7xkcKfse9lnvaSqZhgR_2N9BzXz8OMZyQb_1eRprPArpGve8XGJ0w==) — "The LeadConnector MCP server gives AI assistants a standardized way to work with your LeadConnector data... Claude connects at https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2."

#### **Buildability Verdict**
*   **Verdict:** `ready_now`
*   **Main Blocker:** None. The developer portal and sandbox are self-serve and free. The only hurdle is that end-users must be on a $297/mo plan to use the resulting integration in production.
